articles.full_text:
The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a red alert for Uttarakhand, predicting extremely heavy rainfall and thunderstorms on Sunday, September 26. Meanwhile, an orange alert has been issued for heavy to very heavy rainfall at isolated places over Himachal Pradesh and West Uttar Pradesh.
Thunderstorms accompanied with lightning and gusty winds are also expected across several parts of India, including Delhi, Haryana, Punjab, Madhya Pradesh, on September 27. Here is a look at the weather warnings for September 27 and the following days.
The Char Dham Yatra has also been suspended for September 26 and 27 in Uttarakhand in view of the red alerts issued for rain across most districts of the state.
Uttarakhand is likely to receive heavy to very heavy rainfall with isolated extremely heavy rainfall at some places on September 27.
Himachal Pradesh and West Uttar Pradesh are likely to experience heavy to very heavy rainfall at isolated places, while East Uttar Pradesh, Haryana, Chandigarh, Delhi and Madhya Pradesh may receive isolated heavy rainfall.
Thunderstorms and strong winds
Thunderstorms accompanied by lightning and gusty winds of 40-50 kmph are likely at isolated places over Haryana, Chandigarh, Delhi, Himachal Pradesh, Jammu and Kashmir, Ladakh, Gilgit, Baltistan, Muzaffarabad, Madhya Pradesh, Punjab, Uttarakhand and west Uttar Pradesh.
Gusty winds of 30-40 kmph along with thunderstorms and lightning are also possible over Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Andhra Pradesh, east Uttar Pradesh, Jharkhand, Rajasthan and Telangana.
Arabian Sea warning
Squally winds of 45-55 kmph, gusting to 65 kmph, are likely along and off the Somalia coast adjoining parts of the southwest Arabian Sea.
Upcoming heavy rainfall alerts
Heavy rainfall activity is expected to continue in parts of the country in the coming days. On September 28, isolated heavy rainfall is likely over Himachal Pradesh and Uttarakhand.
On September 29-30, Assam and Meghalaya may receive isolated heavy rainfall, while south interior Karnataka is likely to see very heavy rainfall on September 29. Tamil Nadu, Puducherry and Karaikal are likely to receive isolated heavy rainfall from September 30 to October 1, while Kerala and Mahe may see heavy rainfall during October 1-2.

articles.full_text:
India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a red color warning for very heavy to extremely heavy rainfall along with thunderstorms and lightning over Uttarakhand today. Heavy to very heavy rainfall is also expected over Himachal Pradesh and West Uttar Pradesh.
The IMD said heavy rainfall along with thunderstorms and lightning is also likely to prevail over Delhi, Uttar Pradesh, Haryana, Chandigarh, and Madhya Pradesh.
Thunderstorms and lightning are also expected over Jammu, Kashmir, Ladakh, Gilgit, Baltistan, Muzaffarabad, Madhya Pradesh, and Punjab. Similar conditions are predicted over Andaman and Nicobar Islands, Andhra Pradesh, East Uttar Pradesh, Jharkhand, Rajasthan and Telangana.
Meanwhile, Assam, Meghalaya, Nagaland, Manipur, Mizoram and Tripura are also likely to witness thunderstorms and lightning.
